description: Normalize GVM finding documents at ingest time -- stamps ingested_at, and defaults the human-assessment fields to explicit nulls when the sync script didn't already carry forward a prior assessment. No severity-level filtering here -- threat=Log rows are already dropped in gvm_findings_sync.py before documents are built, not here, to avoid transmitting ~90-95%-noise payloads over the wire (see docs/elasticsearch-stack/README.md section 3).

script.description: Default the human-assessment fields to explicit null only when absent -- same pattern (and same reason: OpenSearch's set processor rejects value:null) as harbor-findings-normalize.json, see project_opensearch_migration_status memory.
script.source: for (field in params.fields) { if (!ctx.containsKey(field)) { ctx.put(field, null); } }
